report_text:
Mapping your luxury shopper's prestige journey at Sephora and Ulta — verifying site tools and evidence.

I've gathered initial signals on loyalty programs, try-on tools, and prestige trends — now pulling exact sources to finalize your profile.

I've confirmed the core loyalty and discovery features — now checking the last prestige assortment details to complete the comparison.

## 1. Sephora: site features and shopping tools
- **[Retailer-specific]** Beauty Insider is the free US rewards program with three spend tiers: Insider, VIB at $350/year and Rouge at $1,000/year, earning 1 point per dollar on Sephora merchandise including Sephora at Kohl's and linked delivery partners. ([About Beauty Insider Loyalty Program | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/loyalty-program))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Beauty Insider Cash lets all members redeem 500 points for $10 off on qualifying $10+ purchases in-store and online, once per transaction. ([About Beauty Insider Loyalty Program | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/loyalty-program))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Rewards Bazaar offers Rewards from 50 to 100,000 points, typically described as deluxe samples, bundles or experiences, with 100-point deluxe-size samples and online three-for-250 offers and new rewards added Tuesdays and Thursdays. ([About Beauty Insider Loyalty Program | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/loyalty-program))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Trending Products page curates what is taking social media by storm across makeup, skincare, fragrance and haircare, providing a prestige-filtered launch and virality entry point. ([Trending Products | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/buy/trending-products))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Site merchandising flags ONLY AT SEPHORA, NEW and LIMITED EDITION, including Sephora Favorites sampler and value sets, supporting curated discovery of exclusives and limited releases. ([Trending Products | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/buy/trending-products))
- **[Inference]** For this persona, Bazaar deluxe samples and choose-with-order samples function as low-risk trial for texture, finish and scent before committing to full-size prestige, consistent with high research_depth (0.80) and prestige_priority (0.90).

## 2. Ulta Beauty: site features and shopping tools
- **[Retailer-specific]** Ulta Beauty Rewards is free with three tiers: Member free, Platinum at $500/year and Diamond at $1,200/year, earning 1, 1.25 and 1.5 points per $1 respectively, with points never expiring for Platinum/Diamond. ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Points redeem for dollars-off starting at 100 points = $3.00 up to 2,000 points = $125.00, usable on qualifying products and beauty services in-store and at checkout online. ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Program includes birthday perks including 2X points month and choice of birthday gift, plus $10 coupon for Platinum/Diamond, $25 off beauty service and full-size gift and free shipping $25+ for Diamond. ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Diamond includes early access to new product launches and exclusive deals, gifts and early access for Platinum/Diamond, relevant to limited-edition urgency. ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Ulta positions prestige discovery via Global Beauty and prestige assortment expansion, exemplified by Japanese prestige brand DECORTÉ launching its Liposome collection in 400 stores building on Ulta.com presence and citing sensorial experience and heritage. ([DECORTÉ Announces Partnership with Ulta Beauty, Bringing Its Signature Liposome Skincare to Select Stores Nationwide](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/decorte-announces-partnership-with-ulta-beauty-bringing-its-signature-liposome-skincare-to-select-stores-nationwide-302925877.html))
- **[Inference]** No verified evidence was found in searched sources for Ulta review-filter design, shade-finder accuracy or sampling specifics, so those tools are not listed as verified for this persona.

## 3. Retailer-specific evidence on how shoppers discover, evaluate and buy
- **[General beauty retail]** Globally reviews and ratings are the top purchase influence with nearly half relying on them, plus friends/family, in-store testing and search engines, and US shoppers browse an average of 19 makeup and 12 fragrance products before purchase. ([New Health & Beauty research: 5 shopper trends every marketer should know](https://www.criteo.com/blog/5-beauty-shopper-trends-2026/))
- **[General beauty retail]** Only 34% rarely switch brands and up to 53% of purchases come from a brand not purchased in prior 12 months, with discovery strongest in the US, and shoppers discover more brands when browsing across multiple retailers. ([New Health & Beauty research: 5 shopper trends every marketer should know](https://www.criteo.com/blog/5-beauty-shopper-trends-2026/))
- **[General beauty retail]** Detailed product descriptions, authentic reviews and clear benefits help shoppers decide, and stronger product content also feeds AI-assisted discovery where 38% use AI and 57% of those say AI recommendations influence purchase. ([New Health & Beauty research: 5 shopper trends every marketer should know](https://www.criteo.com/blog/5-beauty-shopper-trends-2026/))
- **[General beauty retail]** In prestige beauty, experience, design and emotional connection are part of the purchase equation, but luxury positioning alone is insufficient and pricing must be justified by formulation quality, performance outcomes or cultural relevance. ([How Sophisticated Are Beauty Shoppers About Price And Value?](https://www.beautyindependent.com/how-sophisticated-beauty-shoppers-price-value/))
- **[General beauty retail]** Shoppers have learned high price does not guarantee high quality, cited as top frustration, and evaluate Will this work for my needs first, then secondary factors like price, with benefit-aligned ingredients, packaging/design and creator validation as proof points. ([How Sophisticated Are Beauty Shoppers About Price And Value?](https://www.beautyindependent.com/how-sophisticated-beauty-shoppers-price-value/))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Sephora and Ulta both monetize discovery through loyalty visibility: Sephora ties VIB/Rouge status and Bazaar access to annual spend, while Ulta ties accelerated earn and early access to Platinum/Diamond spend, reinforcing multi-retailer browsing to stay in consideration. ([About Beauty Insider Loyalty Program | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/loyalty-program)) ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))

## 4. How this persona's traits show up at Sephora
- **[Inference]** Curated discovery: with novelty_seeking 0.55 and trend_sensitivity 0.40, she browses Trending Products and ONLY AT SEPHORA / LIMITED EDITION edits to filter mass virality for prestige relevance, rather than following every viral item. ([Trending Products | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/buy/trending-products))
- **[Inference]** Deep evaluation (research_depth 0.80): she completes multi-signal check — description and claimed benefits, multiple detailed reviews, comparison of several prestige alternatives, plus expert/sensory evidence — before purchase feels justified, consistent with browsing ~19 products pre-purchase behavior. ([New Health & Beauty research: 5 shopper trends every marketer should know](https://www.criteo.com/blog/5-beauty-shopper-trends-2026/))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Scenario A/C behavior: for $65 vs $35 foundation or limited edition with few reviews, she does not choose on price or scarcity alone; she compares formulation, finish, sensory evidence and performance proof in descriptions and reviews and intensifies investigation for shade/texture/artist validation, delaying if corroboration is missing. ([How Sophisticated Are Beauty Shoppers About Price And Value?](https://www.beautyindependent.com/how-sophisticated-beauty-shoppers-price-value/)) ([Trending Products | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/buy/trending-products))
- **[Inference]** Scenario D: viral affordable blush vs premium MUA-recommended blush — with influencer_trust 0.45 she considers viral only if corroborated by professional/editorial/detailed-review evidence on finish and wear; otherwise retains premium shortlist. Evidence-supported that social proof aids justification, hypothetical in exact threshold.
- **[Retailer-specific]** Scenario B/E: established luxury lipstick vs emerging innovative formula, and elegant expensive skincare vs cheaper stronger-performance option — she shortlists both, favors emerging/cheaper only if superior craft/desirability/experience is shown, otherwise rejects expensive option that fails quality/desirability advantage. ([How Sophisticated Are Beauty Shoppers About Price And Value?](https://www.beautyindependent.com/how-sophisticated-beauty-shoppers-price-value/))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Trial and confidence: she uses Rewards Bazaar deluxe samples and Beauty Insider Cash / Rouge $100 reward mechanics to test and to justify prestige spend, preferring rewarding, inspiring journey over convenience (convenience_priority 0.35). ([About Beauty Insider Loyalty Program | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/loyalty-program))

## 5. How this persona's traits show up at Ulta Beauty
- **[Inference]** Multi-retailer prestige hunting: with brand_loyalty 0.45 she remains open to established and emerging prestige, using Ulta's prestige/Global Beauty assortment to compare premium-to-premium on quality, desirability, reputation and experience. ([DECORTÉ Announces Partnership with Ulta Beauty, Bringing Its Signature Liposome Skincare to Select Stores Nationwide](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/decorte-announces-partnership-with-ulta-beauty-bringing-its-signature-liposome-skincare-to-select-stores-nationwide-302925877.html))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Value justification not discount chasing: with price_sensitivity 0.35 and product_quality_priority 0.90, she treats Ulta's $3–$125 redemption ladder and 1–1.5x earn as confidence-building benefit, not reason to trade down to non-prestige; under budget she buys fewer items, one hero or mini/trial size. ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- **[General beauty retail]** Packaging/sensory check: unboxing, design and sensorial textures shape perceived quality, but she deprioritizes attractive packaging if functionality evidence (application, wear, flaws) is negative, requiring performance proof first. ([How Sophisticated Are Beauty Shoppers About Price And Value?](https://www.beautyindependent.com/how-sophisticated-beauty-shoppers-price-value/))
- **[Inference]** Heritage vs innovation: she treats heritage as tie-breaker only after comparing formulation, texture, finish and reputation; innovative prestige wins only with stronger credible performance/experience proof — evidence-supported principle, hypothetical in weighting.
- **[Retailer-specific]** Exclusivity discipline (impulse 0.35): Diamond early access and exclusive gifts create urgency, but she requires at least basic performance/sensory corroboration before valuing exclusivity, otherwise investigates or defers. ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- **[Inference]** Scenario E at Ulta: elegant expensive skincare vs cheaper stronger-evidence option — she rejects premium if $ premium shows no meaningful sensory/performance advantage, consistent with high price ≠ high quality learning. Hypothetical in store-specific execution.

## 6. Sephora versus Ulta Beauty for this persona
- **[Retailer-specific]** Curation signal: Sephora's verified ONLY AT SEPHORA / LIMITED EDITION / Trending merchandising maps more directly to her prestige-launch filter than Ulta's verified strengths in tiered dollars-off and prestige expansion via Global Beauty. ([Trending Products | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/buy/trending-products)) ([DECORTÉ Announces Partnership with Ulta Beauty, Bringing Its Signature Liposome Skincare to Select Stores Nationwide](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/decorte-announces-partnership-with-ulta-beauty-bringing-its-signature-liposome-skincare-to-select-stores-nationwide-302925877.html))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Rewards psychology: Sephora rewards with samples/experiences and $10 Cash / $100 Rouge Reward; Ulta rewards with direct dollars-off ladder and beauty-service credit, the former better matching indulgent experience, the latter better for mixed-basket value while staying prestige. ([About Beauty Insider Loyalty Program | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/loyalty-program)) ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- **[Inference]** Where she buys: she prefers the source offering more rewarding, inspiring and confidence-building journey with sampling/returns support over convenience or price alone, so Sephora edges for exclusive discovery rituals, Ulta for prestige-plus-service and early access. Hypothetical, to be tested in simulation.
- **[General beauty retail]** Both benefit from her cross-retailer comparison habit, since shoppers browsing multiple sites discover more brands and evaluate more items before checkout. ([New Health & Beauty research: 5 shopper trends every marketer should know](https://www.criteo.com/blog/5-beauty-shopper-trends-2026/))
- **[Inference]** Versus adjacent personas: unlike Trend-Driven she filters virality through MUA/editorial curation; unlike Sensitive-Skin/Time-Constrained quality means finish, texture and craft not tolerability/ease; unlike Price-Sensitive she weighs desirability/experience against price not cost-per-use. Hypothetical distinctions for simulation.

## 7. Evidence quality and gaps
- **[General beauty retail]** Strong general evidence on research-driven prestige evaluation, price justification and emotional/experiential value from trade press and 4,500+ shopper survey, but not Sephora/Ulta-split. ([New Health & Beauty research: 5 shopper trends every marketer should know](https://www.criteo.com/blog/5-beauty-shopper-trends-2026/)) ([How Sophisticated Are Beauty Shoppers About Price And Value?](https://www.beautyindependent.com/how-sophisticated-beauty-shoppers-price-value/))
- **[Retailer-specific]** Verified retailer evidence limited to loyalty terms and Sephora trending/exclusivity flags and one Ulta prestige partnership; no verified US retailer-specific data found on review-filter use, try-on conversion, or MUA recommendation placement. ([About Beauty Insider Loyalty Program | Sephora](https://www.sephora.com/beauty/loyalty-program)) ([Ulta Beauty Rewards: Points for Dollars Off & Perks | Ulta Beauty](https://www.ulta.com/rewards/all))
- **[Inference]** No credible US source verified exact return windows, free-sample quantities, or mini/deluxe trial assortments in this search, so sampling/shade-match/return tactics are modeled as investigation needs, not listed as guaranteed features.
- **[Inference]** Willingness-to-pay premiums for packaging/exclusivity is supported as directional insight but specific uplift rates and dupe-equivalence thresholds were not verified; do not hard-code statistics in simulation.
- **[Inference]** All decision-rule weightings linking scores (e.g., research_depth 0.80 requiring multi-signal check, prestige_priority 0.90 overriding convenience) are hypotheses to test, not empirical findings, and should be varied under restricted budget missions.
